vault_line: Im Glad she ain't Medusa, when she kissed me would of turned me into stone

chip_form: Im Glad she ain't Medusa, when she kissed me would of turned me into stone (gorgon three)
note_excerpt: Medusa was a Gorgon, one of three sisters in Greek Mythology. She was originally a very beautiful woman, but the goddess Athena was angered by her vanity and punished her by turning her into a hideous monster with snakes for hair and whose stare could turn someone to stone.
